data.name: The Second Initiation
data.detailed_description:
You are a sorcerer born in an era when the Dark Lords of the Bebshoru Lodbuka Hell claim dominion over the entire known world. You belong to the Enchmonlain order of sorcerers, whose temple stands high in the mountains, on the edge of the violent sea that surrounds the island. In your youth, you will meet a woman named Negtelitza, and she will be part of your story until the end of your days, but the paths you travel and the endings you find will depend on the choices you make along the way.

Nothing is easy here on the volcanic island of Abunouzeppan; everything can become complicated if you make bad decisions that lead to tragic endings, but you can also forge relationships and see happy endings if that’s what results from the choices you make along the way. Many characters are there living their lives, and sometimes you can talk to them, or some will even invite you into their presence. Additionally, unexpected events will occur, to which you can react or ignore as you wish.

Although the plot isn’t set in stone, it unfolds in a land where darkness and tragedy prevail, a place where life isn’t easy and almost anything goes to survive and fulfilll one’s destiny. Here, no one applauds you for being a good Samaritan; instead, they might crush you without mercy unless you find trustworthy companions who won’t betray you. The Dark Lords of Hell Bebshoru Lodbuka have no mercy and will stop at nothing to achieve their goals. Trekim Gogzokk, the Dark Lord, hails from a parallel universe and was born to dominate the Milky Way, so he established himself in the deep caves of the Abunouzeppan Mountains, and from there he claims absolute control over everything that happens on the surface with his nearly limitless psychic powers. The Dark Lord may also meet his consort, the Queen of Orion, if events dictate, based on your choices. You’ll also meet the order of dark sorcerers, immortal humans, extraterrestrials from the star Sirius, the palace butler and housekeeper, the Secretary of Hell, and many other characters who will test your cunning and survival instincts.

In the end, you’ll be able to influence many events on the island, but keep in mind that most of your decisions are irreversible and cannot be changed once you’ve made them, so you’ll have to deal with their consequences from then on.

You start in an apparently peaceful and inhospitable world, but as time passes, everything can become deeper and darker.

The game involves interacting with characters thru text-based conversations in which you must choose one of several available options, and depending on the option you select, the story will take different alternative paths. There isn’t a single story; instead, events unfold according to the decisions you make, so each playthrough can be different if you choose other options. For example, when you choose a response in a conversation with a character in the story, it will determine the subsequent conversations with any other character and also the events that follow in that story.

When you finish a conversation, a map will appear where you can choose your next destination or go to the market to buy certain useful items. Additionally, you can obtain other items by building relationships with the characters.

At first, not everything is unlocked; many characters and locations are unavailable, and you’ll need to unlock them by choosing the right options in conversations.

data.short_description: A role-playing game where you are a sorcerer living in a world dominated by the Dark Lords of Hell. You must make decisions that will lead you down different paths and alternate endings; you can create happy endings, but if you’re not careful, you’ll witness tragedies along the way…
data.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Thai, Traditional Chinese
